subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw add one ignored metadata field to all relevant channel group/channel config entries, and should the canonical key be `name`, `label`, or `description`?
rationale: This is a public config-contract addition across multiple channels; automation can implement it once the durable field name and scope are confirmed, but should not invent that contract.

options.title: Add `name` consistently
options.body: Adopt `name?: string` as ignored metadata across relevant group/channel entry schemas and docs, matching the reporter's concrete example and keeping config concise.

options.title: Use `label` or `description`
options.body: Pick a more explicitly display-only key, accepting the need to document its semantics carefully to avoid confusion with runtime name matching.

options.title: Decline metadata for now
options.body: Keep strict behavior-only group entries and instead improve docs or discovery tooling around platform IDs.

recommendation.title: Add `name` consistently
recommendation.body: Adopt `name?: string` as ignored metadata across relevant group/channel entry schemas and docs, matching the reporter's concrete example and keeping config concise.

likelyOwner.reason: The central config schema history and prior review context make steipete the best available product-contract owner for this decision.
